open_questions.question: Which exact section change first breaks cross-donor mixed IC generation in MIXED_IC_CROSS_DONOR_ISOLATION_V1_TEMP_2026_06_09: same-donor region extraction, sparse CDB rows, first-header donor bytes, filtered device definitions, or full multi donor device sections?
open_questions.notes: Test in order and report the first failing case. T00/T01 are same-donor controls; T04-T09 isolate the clean T02/T04 failure shapes.
open_questions.answer: User Proteus testing showed T00/T01/T02 worked, while T03 onward crashed before opening. This identifies missing/filtered foreign device metadata as unsafe: T02 worked with full multi-donor device sections, T03 crashed without the foreign section, and later filtered-device cases crashed. CDB/header policy remains unresolved because T02 worked with full misc donor CDB even though it did not correctly describe the foreign divider ICs.

open_questions.answer: User Proteus testing of Isolation V2 showed complete donor CDB cases worked: T00, T03, T05, T06, T07, and T10. Every generated/stitched CDB case from the old slicer crashed before open: T01, T02, T04, T08, T09, and T11. This rejects the old ASCII-based CDB row slicer, but not parser-based CDB synthesis.

open_questions.question: Do corrected parser-built CDB rows work for cross-donor IC mixes in MIXED_IC_CROSS_DONOR_CDB_V1_CORRECT_ROWS_TEMP_2026_06_09, and does Proteus prefer original donor ordinals or renumbered emitted ordinals?
open_questions.notes: Test T00-T11 in order. T00/T06 are full-CDB controls. T01-T03 and T07-T09 preserve donor row ordinals. T04-T05 and T10-T11 renumber internal CDB ordinals to emitted row order.
open_questions.answer: User Proteus testing reported only T00 and T06 worked. Every reduced generated-CDB case crashed before opening, including both original-donor-ordinal and renumbered-ordinal variants. Correct row boundaries and property-row trailer adaptation are necessary but not sufficient when the full donor CDB skeleton/count is reduced.

open_questions.question: Does full-skeleton CDB generation work for cross-donor IC mixes when the complete donor CDB row universe is preserved and only selected matching rows are replaced?
open_questions.notes: Test T00-T10 in order. T00/T04/T06/T07 are full-CDB controls. T01-T03 replace U4-U6 inside the full misc CDB skeleton. T05 replaces U2-U3 inside the full counter skeleton. T08-T10 replace U4 inside the full counter skeleton.
open_questions.answer: User Proteus testing reported all CDB V2 cases worked except T05. T05 did not crash; it opened far enough to report a DLL error. This accepts full donor CDB skeleton preservation and selected row replacement generally, but leaves the specific counter-skeleton U2/U3 shift-register replacement path unresolved.

open_questions.question: Which part of CDB V2 T05 causes the DLL error: replacing U2, replacing U3, property rows, pin rows, or the combination?
open_questions.notes: Test T00-T10 in order. T03 reproduces the failing V2 T05. T01/T02 split U2 versus U3. T04-T09 split property rows versus pin rows.
open_questions.answer: User Proteus testing reported all V3 T05 isolation cases worked. Therefore U2 replacement, U3 replacement, U2+U3 replacement, property-only replacement, and pin-only replacement are all accepted when generated through the focused full-skeleton CDB route. The earlier V2 T05 DLL error is not a blocking rule for mixing.

open_questions.question: Do MIXED_IC_CROSS_DONOR_ACCEPTED_V1_TEMP_2026_06_10 practical mixed sequential/misc IC projects open/render/simulate when generated with full donor device sections and full CDB skeleton row replacement?
open_questions.notes: User tested V1. T01, T02, T04, T05, and T07 opened and simulated. T01 and T05 were visually too close. T03 opened but did not simulate; moving U2 in Proteus and saving auto-fixed the first CDB/pin issue, then a no-model error appeared for U9. T06 opened but did not simulate with a missing CDB element record for U3. T08 opened but did not simulate with no model specified for U9. The misc 74HC157 region remains excluded because its visible region uses U50 while its package CDB row is U5.
open_questions.answer: The accepted full-skeleton CDB policy is broadly viable for practical mixed sequential/misc IC projects, but V1 is not final. Whole-region layout separation is needed before packing large mixed IC cases, and visible 74HC4060/U9 must be isolated because it produced no-model simulation errors.

open_questions.question: Does MIXED_IC_CROSS_DONOR_ACCEPTED_V2_LAYOUT_TEMP_2026_06_10 fix V1 close/overlap CDB-pin failures by translating complete IC regions and excluding visible 74HC4060/U9?
open_questions.notes: User Proteus testing reported: T01/T02/T04/T06/T07/T08 opened and simulated but all had visible artifacts; T03 opened but did not simulate and had artifacts; T05 opened with artifacts and did not simulate. The screenshots show floating terminal labels and component ID/value text from moved IC regions.
open_questions.answer: No. V2 is rejected as a layout method. It moved IC bodies, WIRE endpoints, and terminal symbols but failed to move $TERBIDIR terminal-label coordinates and component text/value/subckt coordinate fields. Broad IC mixing must pause until the complete-region translation moves all of those fields together. Removing visible 74HC4060 was also the wrong direction; use focused 4060 diagnostics instead.

open_questions.question: Does MIXED_IC_FOCUSED_V3_TEMP_2026_06_10 fix V2's floating text artifacts and provide useful small analog/RLC/4060/NE555 evidence?
open_questions.notes: User Proteus testing reported T01/T02 did not work. T03/T04/T07 opened, and only T05/T06 had simulation errors. T05/T06 failed in partition analysis with no model specified for visible 74HC4060 refs.
open_questions.answer: V3 is not accepted as a mixed sequential IC layout method. The coordinate-scan translation used for T01/T02 is rejected because it can touch non-coordinate binary fields. The useful evidence from V3 is that complete real mixed analog/RLC subsets still open, and that 74HC4060 needs model-metadata investigation rather than removal.

open_questions.question: Does MIXED_IC_FOCUSED_V4_TEMP_2026_06_10 restore T01/T02 with no-layout accepted baselines and fix 74HC4060 simulation by patching DSN/CDB model metadata?

open_questions.answer: V4 partially restored the focused pack by backing out V3 coordinate scanning, but the 74HC4060 VOLTAGE/MODFILE instance patch is rejected. Do not add VOLTAGE=4.5V to 74HC4060 CDB/DSN instance properties.

open_questions.question: Does MIXED_IC_FOCUSED_V5_DONOR_NATIVE_TEMP_2026_06_10 make 74HC4060 simulate by preserving donor-native metadata while applying label/topology edits inside the donor project?

open_questions.answer: No for 74HC4060 simulation. Donor-native preservation did not make 4060 simulate: even the exact donor-native 4x 4060+RLC repack failed with no model specified. Yes for the analog/basic and NE555 routes: T05 and T06 worked properly.

open_questions.answer: V6 was the smallest no-4060 follow-up and all cases opened/simulated, but the user rejected the functional intent because terminal names were not same as the case names implied. Do not expand this topology mutation route until terminal-name semantics are verified in Proteus.
